scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.docker:dev:up: cd PRI/ && docker compose -f docker-compose-dev.yaml up
scripts.docker:dev:down: cd PRI/ && docker compose -f docker-compose-dev.yaml down
scripts.docker:prod:up: cd PRI/ && docker compose -f docker-compose-prod.yaml up
scripts.docker:prod:down: cd PRI/ && docker compose -f docker-compose-prod.yaml down
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
